name: Free Table
tagline: A real deck on a virtual table. Play any game, house rules welcome.
rulesSummary: No rules enforced: deal, draw, play, discard and bet however your game works.
Rummy-style: lay down melds in front of you and add to anyone's melds. Tap the discard pile to take its top card.
Pass… sends selected cards face down to the player on your left, right, or anyone you choose.
The ••• menu has more: discard face down, put cards on the bottom or top of the deck, flip, deal, shuffle, bet.
Tap cards to select or deselect them, then pick an action. Swipe a card up to play it face up. ✕ Clear, or a tap on the felt, deselects everything.
Undo is available for everyone, so mistakes are cheap.
